title: Koszul Duality for Quadratic Monomial Algebras
summary: Let \(Λ\) be a quadratic monomial algebra and let \(Λ^{!}\) denote its Koszul dual. We study finitely presented and finitely copresented graded modules over \(Λ\) and \(Λ^{!}\), and use this structure to obtain explicit forms of derived and singular Koszul duality. We prove that quadratic monomial algebras are both graded coherent and graded cocoherent. Applying this to the Koszul dual \(Λ^{!}\), which is again quadratic monomial, we show that finitely presented and finitely copresented graded \(Λ^{!}\)-modules coincide with perfect and coperfect modules, respectively.
